title: Make dashboard://pane links readable on the Claude screen
notes: Pane links in the Claude screen's transcript (the 'pane 0:5' link in worker notices and in tool output, from PR #176) render in the browser's default link blue on the dark bubble, which is hard to read (screenshot from the user, 2026-11-04). Give them the screen's own link colour from the theme, with a visited/hover state and enough contrast on both the dark prompt bubble and the transcript background (check WCAG AA, 4.5:1, for the text size used). Also make them reachable from the keyboard like other transcript links (card 5f5b62b8 lists that). CSS in the chat stylesheet; no test needed beyond the existing link parsing ones; check by hand in the app.
